# Coronis Health

> Coronis Health is a leading medical billing and revenue cycle management (RCM) outsourcing company serving diverse healthcare organizations with AI-powered solutions and specialized expertise.

Coronis Health provides comprehensive RCM services across multiple healthcare verticals including hospitals, physician groups, behavioral health centers, and community health organizations. The company leverages proprietary methodologies like The Coronis Way and AI automation to optimize revenue, reduce denials, and improve financial operations for healthcare providers.

## Key Topics

- Revenue Cycle Management (RCM)
- Medical Billing
- Claims Management
- Denial Management
- Healthcare Outsourcing
- AI Automation
- The Coronis Way
- Billing Coding
- Cash Flow Optimization
- Healthcare Financial Operations
- DRG Optimization
- CMI Optimization
- Medicaid Billing
- EHR Integration
- Healthcare Organizations

## Healthcare Organization Solutions

- [Hospital Revenue Cycle Management](https://coronishealth.com/who-we-serve/hospital): Hospital RCM with Coronis Way methodology for DRG and CMI optimization
- [Health System Revenue Cycle Management](https://coronishealth.com/who-we-serve/health-system): Health system RCM solutions addressing denials, coding, and revenue optimization
- [Hospital-Affiliated RCM and Medical Billing](https://coronishealth.com/who-we-serve/hospital-affiliated): RCM and billing solutions for hospital-affiliated providers with AI automation
- [Physician Revenue Cycle Management](https://coronishealth.com/who-we-serve/physician-group): Physician group RCM and billing services accelerating revenue and reducing admin
- [Behavioral Health Revenue Cycle Management](https://coronishealth.com/who-we-serve/behavioral-health): Behavioral health RCM solutions for inpatient and outpatient programs
- [Community Health Billing and RCM Services](https://coronishealth.com/who-we-serve/community-health): Community health center billing and RCM services with customized solutions
